tax.text: She introduced a bill to tax certain financial trades and reinvest the revenue in schools, housing, and infrastructure.
tax.quote: This small, targeted tax will raise hundreds of billions from those who can afford it and reinvest it in things that actually help people—like schools, housing, and infrastructure.

wages.text: She says she helped increase Oregon’s minimum wage and supports legislation to make union organizing easier.
wages.quote: In the Legislature, she fought for paid sick leave, increasing Oregon’s minimum wage, and for the largest increase in public education funding in Oregon history.

trade.text: She opposed a proposed 50 percent tariff on Canadian wildfire aircraft and parts.
trade.quote: Imposing a 50 percent tariff on these aircraft or stripping their certification would either make these planes too expensive to keep under contract or prevent them from flying at all

debt.text: She introduced legislation to expand Social Security benefits and supports protecting Social Security and Medicare.
debt.quote: The legislation we are introducing today will expand Social Security benefits by $2,400 a year, lift millions of seniors out of poverty and extend the solvency of Social Security for generations to come

housing.text: She supports increasing housing supply and has backed federal funding and tax credits for new homes.
housing.quote: From workforce housing to high income housing we need to invest in building more homes and apartments to address the extreme shortage of housing at all levels.

schools.text: She supports protecting public school funding and increasing federal investment in rural, Tribal, and frontier schools.
schools.quote: Protect funding for public schools, including Title I and IDEA, funds for low income and special education students

safety.text: She requested federal funds for police response equipment and community policing projects.
safety.quote: Springfield Police Emergency Response Equipment - Springfield, OR - $1,000,000

guns.text: She cosponsored legislation to strengthen federal firearm background-check procedures.
guns.quote: To amend chapter 44 of title 18, United States Code, to strengthen the background check procedures to be followed before a Federal firearms licensee may transfer a firearm to a person who is not such a licensee.

abortion.text: She supports restoring nationwide abortion protections and opposes a national abortion ban.
abortion.quote: I am deeply committed to continue fighting in Congress to restore the national protections of Roe v. Wade and will oppose any national ban on abortions, contraceptives or IVF.

gender.text: She voted against the House bill that would have based school-sports sex rules on biology and genetics at birth.
gender.quote: Protection of Women and Girls in Sports Act

cannabis.text: She said she would continue the fight for cannabis legalization and cannabis banking access.
cannabis.quote: He has fought tirelessly for cannabis legalization and access to banking, and we will continue that fight.

health.text: She said she supports Medicare for All to provide everyone a basic level of health care.
health.quote: I believe that we need Medicare for All, so that everyone has a basic level of health care, that’s important.

energy.text: She called for moving to green energy quickly and has supported policies to reduce carbon emissions.
energy.quote: The fact is, this is a crisis and we have to do everything we can from every single agency, to move to green energy as quickly as possible.

voting.text: She introduced the Vote at Home Act to expand accessible voting options.
voting.quote: introduced the Vote at Home Act to provide a new path forward on voting that makes elections more accessible, more secure, and more affordable.

housing.text: She supports increasing housing supply by reducing regulatory barriers and streamlining permitting.
housing.quote: I support ending prohibitive and inflationary policies that stifle new construction with excessive permitting costs, building regulations, city and county codes, bureaucratic red tape, and outdated land-use restrictions imposed by the government itself.

safety.text: She supports providing law enforcement with resources and authority, and opposes federal funding for cities that defund police.
safety.quote: I support the rule of law and the men and women of law enforcement and other emergency responders.

immigration.text: She supports border enforcement and removing dangerous criminals, as well as an earned lawful-status opportunity for some long-settled, noncriminal residents.
immigration.quote: Indiscriminate mass deportation is neither a realistic nor constructive solution.

abortion.text: She opposes a federal abortion ban and says she would protect Oregon’s abortion laws from changes by Congress.
abortion.quote: I oppose a federal ban on abortion, and I support access to IVF treatments.

tax.text: He proposes raising taxes on ultra-wealthy people to generate additional public revenue.
tax.quote: Additional revenue would be secured through higher taxation of the ultra-wealthy.

wages.text: He proposes a $25 hourly minimum wage and expanded union rights.
wages.quote: A universal minimum wage of $25 per hour shall be enacted, indexed to both inflation and productivity growth, and all sub-minimum wage exemptions shall be eliminated.

trade.text: He proposes global fair-trade agreements intended to protect workers and communities.
trade.quote: global fair trade agreements should be established to protect workers and communities.

debt.text: He proposes increasing Social Security revenue by removing the high-income contribution cap and taxing capital gains and dividends.
debt.quote: the artificial cap on Social Security contributions for high-income earners should be removed, and the Social Security tax extended to capital gains and dividend income.

safety.text: He supports restorative justice, rehabilitation, and community oversight of policing.
safety.quote: We believe in a justice system that prioritizes rehabilitation, accountability, and community safety.

immigration.text: He supports expanded visas and refugee programs, stronger DACA protections, and a path to citizenship for undocumented immigrants.
immigration.quote: Refugee programs and visa availability should be significantly expanded, while DACA protections should be strengthened and updated.

abortion.text: He opposes a federal abortion ban and supports codifying reproductive rights in law.
abortion.quote: No. I believe in women’s reproductive rights and I would support codifying it in law.

health.text: He supports a national Medicare for All program and cancellation of outstanding medical debt.
health.quote: A national improved Medicare for All program should be implemented to guarantee universal access to quality care, while all outstanding medical debt should be canceled to relieve financial burdens on patients.

energy.text: He calls for a climate emergency declaration, a ban on fracking, and a rapid transition to renewable power.
energy.quote: A national climate emergency should be declared, establishing the foundation for a Real Green New Deal that prioritizes sustainable development, social equity, and economic resilience.
